name: @shepherd/ui
description: The Shepherd primitive set. PUBLIC: an extension imports this so its view looks native and re-themes for free.
//exports: Two entries and no more. `.` is the components; `./styles.css` is the ONE stylesheet a page loads (it is not injected — a stylesheet that mounts itself is a stylesheet whose order nobody controls). Behind that single specifier is a file per component, chained by `@import`: the specifier is the public contract and the split is an implementation detail, so a thirteenth primitive is a new file plus one import line rather than an edit to what consumers write.
//peerDependencies: React is the HOST's, not ours. Two copies of react in one page is two reconcilers, and the hook errors it produces name a file that is not the problem. `react-dom` joined it with Radix, which portals — and a portal from a second react-dom renders into a tree the host's reconciler does not own.
